data.fund_name: LIC MF Large & Mid Cap Fund
data.fund_type: An open ended equity scheme investing in both large cap and mid cap stocks
data.investment_objective: To generate long term capital appreciation by investing substantially in a portfolio of equity and equity linked instruments of large cap and midcap companies. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Equity & Equity related instruments of large cap companies, Mid Cap Companies : 70-100%, Debt & Money market instruments. (including investments in securitized debt):0-30%. Please refer the Scheme Information Document for complete details.
data.fund_managers: FM -1-Mr. Yogesh Patil, FM -2-Mr. Dikshit Mittal
data.exit_load: 12% of the units allotted shall be redeemed or switched out without any exit load, on or before completion of 3 months from the date of allotment of units., 1% on remaining units if redeemed or switched out on or before completion of 3 months from the date of allotment of units. , Nil, if redeemed or switched out after completion of 3 months from the date of allotment of units.
